story.title: Appeal Filed in Erin Patterson's Mushroom Murder Conviction Over Jury Issues
story.summary: Erin Patterson's defense team has filed an appeal against her conviction for the murder of three relatives using a toxic mushroom dish. They argue that the jury was not properly sequestered during the trial, which they claim undermines the integrity of the verdict. The appeal highlights a significant hotel mix-up that the defense describes as 'catastrophic.'

related_stories.title: Israel Launches Criminal Investigations into Killings of Hind Rajab and Gaza Rescue Workers
related_stories.summary: Israel's military announced it will conduct criminal investigations into two significant incidents involving the deaths of Palestinians. The probes will focus on the killing of 5-year-old Hind Rajab and her family in January 2024, as well as the deaths of 15 Palestinian paramedics in March 2025. This decision follows a review of 150 incidents related to the actions of Israeli troops during the conflict.

related_stories.title: Hayden Panettiere Found Unresponsive; Boyfriend Present at Scene
related_stories.summary: Hayden Panettiere was found unresponsive in a Greenville, South Carolina apartment over the weekend. Her on-and-off boyfriend, Brian Hickerson, and his brother were present and called 911. Reports indicate that Hickerson handed police a bag of medication after her death. The circumstances surrounding her passing are under investigation, with some suggesting a possible overdose.

related_stories.title: Remains of Climbers Missing for 34 Years Discovered in Swiss Alps
related_stories.summary: The bodies of two Belgian climbers who disappeared in the Swiss Alps in 1992 have been recovered from a melting glacier, according to police reports. The Wallis police maintain records of missing persons dating back to 1925, primarily in mountainous regions and rivers.

related_stories.title: Police Confirm Thai Teen Found in Suitcase Died from Suffocation
related_stories.summary: Authorities have determined that Tunchanok Donholma, a Thai teenager found in a suitcase in Pattaya, died from suffocation. This conclusion comes as new evidence has emerged regarding her alleged murder, which took place in June.
